Service desk

Demo only. Use fictional details. Changes stay in this browser, with no agency connection. Role switching demonstrates the workflow and does not enforce identity or secure access.


Try the complete workflow in three minutes
  1. As Requester, report a fictional device fault with a title and description.
  2. Switch to Coordinator, open the new request and assign a technician.
  3. Switch to Technician, start work, then add a resolution of at least 10 characters.
  4. Switch to Requester, reject with a reason or confirm that service is restored.
  5. Review the history. Use filters, export the queue or reset to the original sample.
